EXACT EXPECTATION PROVENANCE SUMMARY
- getCombinedKnownVersionsAsync in the installed nested @expo/cli@57.0.24 calls getVersionedNativeModulesAsync and getRemoteVersionsForSdkAsync, then merges local and remote maps with ...versionsForSdk last. Its inline comment explicitly states remote versions are preferred to push emergency fixes without requiring an expo package update.
- getVersionsAsync calls official https://api.expo.dev/v2/versions/latest; getNativeModuleVersionsAsync calls https://api.expo.dev/v2/sdks/57.0.0/native-modules.
- The raw Expo Doctor/install-check failures therefore originate in the official remote SDK 57 expectation table. The installed xpo@57.0.22 bundled map is fallback/local metadata and specifies xpo-notifications ~57.0.18; it is overridden while online.
- The nested CLI is package-resolved under xpo; it is not a direct project dependency and was not added or pinned.
